recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the missed ProductShelfLife page cleanup without changing the datatype model or taking up the separate no-change storage-condition proposal.
issue_request: FHIR-29401 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the BR&R ProductShelfLife datatype. It requested cleanup of ProductShelfLife content that still identified Pharmacy ownership, included Dosage-derived material, or otherwise was inappropriate.
initial_application: Commit c8353788585402430d542e0e87f766b51e424181 partially applied the issue by changing only source/productshelflife.html from Pharmacy to BR&R. Earlier history had removed TODO/interpretation placeholder content, but the ProductShelfLife definitions, examples, mappings, and profiles pages still carried Pharmacy ownership, and the examples page still referenced the retired MedicinalProductPackaged name.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists ProductShelfLife as a datatype, maps productshelflife to the ProductShelfLife page family, and marks ProductShelfLife normative. source/hierarchy.xml includes the ProductShelfLife examples, definitions, mappings, and profiles pages. BR&R 2026-04-14 minutes recorded FHIR-29401 as a technical correction for Rik to update as appropriate. FHIR-28256 is a separate ProductShelfLife storage-condition request resolved no-change and did not require a structural edit here.
reconciliation: Changed the active ProductShelfLife definitions, examples, mappings, and profiles pages from Pharmacy work group macros to BR&R, and changed the examples page to link to current PackagedProductDefinition examples where ProductShelfLife is used.
source_changes: source/productshelflife-definitions.html: changed ProductShelfLife detailed descriptions owner from Pharmacy to BR&R.
source/productshelflife-examples.html: changed owner from Pharmacy to BR&R and replaced the stale MedicinalProductPackaged example reference with a PackagedProductDefinition examples link.
source/productshelflife-mappings.html: changed ProductShelfLife mappings owner from Pharmacy to BR&R.
source/productshelflife-profiles.html: changed ProductShelfLife profiles owner from Pharmacy to BR&R.
